source_caption:
🎥🍿: Ebenezer 

Christmas Eve becomes a waking nightmare when the bitter Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by the ghost of his former business partner, warning that his soul is destined for eternal torment unless he changes his ways. As midnight approaches, three mysterious spirits pull him through a series of haunting visions that expose the choices that shaped his life.

From the innocence he abandoned to the lives shattered by his relentless greed, Scrooge is forced to witness the human cost of his actions. But the final journey is the most terrifying of all, revealing a future where his legacy is one of loneliness, fear, and despair. With dawn fast approaching, Scrooge must decide whether redemption is still possible before his fate is sealed forever.

source_details.synopsis: Ebenezer is a 1998 Canadian made-for-television fantasy drama Western film starring Jack Palance and Ricky Schroder. It is a re-telling of Charles Dickens' classic 1843 novella A Christmas Carol with Jack Palance giving a performance as Ebenezer Scrooge, á la Western genre. A TV film with high production value, it premiered in the United States on November 25, 1998 on TNT. It is an obscure and rarely seen title.
